tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by three different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Reported by Reuters: OpenAI sued for trademark infringement over 'Astra' AI model.
Reported by MLex: OpenAI introduces text watermarking to meet EU AI Act requirements.
Confirmed, per citybiz: Collibra Acquires trail ML to Automate AI Governance From Policy to Production.
Confirmed, per BeBeez International: AI cloud startup Verda raises $189m in Series B funding round.
Confirmed, per The Next Web: Security teams are starting to treat AI like staff, and that means managing it.
